title: Ellecaboh Mayballaah Ayro
intro: Caylih kaxxa mayballaah seecimteeh, duddale xayyossah tan butta ken mano amotani milaagtah tan qammalsime wayta numma foocal ken geen.
clues: Nanu ninni gabâ taamah, soonoonuu kee cogdah abbobti tamixxige.
Nanu miraacak seecimneh sugnem sahlin adoytit yabbixe gexkalootu foocal abnuh.
nanu numma nuble waqdi, nanu sujuudul radne, baad rabbil naamineemi.
gadaabe gibdi digaalah nee meysiiseh, takkay immay nanu maqambaalinno.
Nanu qado asta nubleek lakal farmol naamine marak sugne.
Nanu ninni imaanal shahiidneh sugne, takkay immay nanu naharak jannat culle numma le mara luk.
arabic: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًۭا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَـٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ
verse: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses." (20:70)
